what even is a REST API? my lecturer explained it but i still don't get it
think of it like ordering food. you tell the waiter what you want (HTTP request), waiter goes to kitchen (server), brings back your food (response). you don't care how the kitchen works
okay that makes sense. what's the difference between GET and POST?
GET = fetch something. POST = send something to create or change. GET is like asking 'what's on the menu', POST is like placing an order

difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?
supervised: ada label, model belajar dari contoh yang udah dijawab. unsupervised: ga ada label, model cari pola sendiri
which one is more common in practice?
supervised by far. klasifikasi, deteksi, prediksi — semua supervised. unsupervised biasa dipake buat clustering atau anomaly detection

what's the point of using TypeScript over JavaScript?
types catch bugs before you run anything. pass a string where a number goes — TS yells at you immediately, JS waits until it crashes
is it worth the extra setup?

apa itu Big O notation?
cara ngukur seberapa lambat algoritma lu pas input-nya makin gede. O(n) artinya kalo input dobel, waktu dobel. O(1) artinya selalu sama cepatnya
O(n²) berarti?
input dobel, waktu jadi 4x. nested loop biasanya O(n²). hindarin kalo bisa

explain docker like i've never heard of it
your app works on your laptop but breaks on your friend's machine. docker packages your app AND its whole environment into a box. whoever runs the box gets the exact same setup
so it's like a VM?
similar idea but lighter. VM emulates a whole OS. docker shares the host OS kernel, just isolates the app. faster to spin up, less overhead

what's a deadlock in programming?
dua thread masing-masing nunggu yang satunya selesai duluan — jadinya dua-duanya stuck selamanya
gimana cara hindarinya?
acquire lock selalu dalam urutan yang sama, pake timeout, atau redesign supaya thread-nya ga perlu nunggu satu sama lain
gue ga ngerti pointer di C, tolong
pointer itu alamat rumah, bukan rumahnya. `int x = 5` → x isinya 5. `int *p = &x` → p nyimpen alamat x di memory. `*p` artinya pergi ke alamat itu
jadi & itu ngambil alamatnya?
yep. `&` = kasih gue alamatnya. `*` = pergi ke alamat itu. dua operator itu doang yang bikin orang bingung 90% of the time

apa bedanya SQL sama NoSQL?
SQL: tabel, struktur ketat, ada relasi. NoSQL: fleksibel, bisa JSON bebas, scale-nya lebih gampang secara horizontal
kapan mending pake yang mana?

gimana cara bikin function yang nerima unlimited arguments di python?

```python
def fungsi(*args, **kwargs):
    print(args)   # tuple
    print(kwargs) # dict
```
`*args` buat positional, `**kwargs` buat keyword
contoh panggilnya gimana?
`fungsi(1, 2, 3, nama='vegard')` → args jadi `(1,2,3)`, kwargs jadi `{'nama': 'vegard'}`
gue lagi stuck di soal greedy algorithm, ga tau harus mulai dari mana
greedy itu selalu ambil yang paling optimal sekarang, tanpa mikir ke depan. tanya ke diri sendiri: kalau tiap langkah gue ambil yang paling [besar/kecil/murah], apa hasilnya bener?
gimana cara tau greedy works atau ga buat suatu soal?
coba prove greedy choice property — pilihan greedy di setiap step ga akan bikin solusi global jadi suboptimal. kalo susah prove, mungkin emang butuh DP
what happens when you type a URL in the browser?
DNS lookup untuk convert domain ke IP → TCP connection → TLS handshake kalo HTTPS → HTTP request ke server → server kirim balik HTML/CSS/JS → browser render
which step is usually the slowest?
DNS lookup kalo belum di-cache, atau TLS handshake di koneksi pertama. makanya HTTPS preconnect hints exist — browser bisa mulai handshake lebih awal
